summary: Ellington Credit Company filed an 8-K announcing a monthly common dividend of $0.08 per share declared by its Board of Trustees, payable July 31, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation; the filing includes only the press release as an exhibit. No event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or management change is involved. The filing is a standard ongoing disclosure with no deal terms, premium, or strategic action.
